passages.text: Prior to the flood the supraglacial lake measured around 0.75 square kilometres, reduced to roughly 0.60 square kilometres after.
DHM and ICIMOD confirmed a glacial lake outburst as the cause, based on Sentinel-2 imagery and open-source platforms. The glacier name is rendered both 'Pyurepu' and 'Purepu' across sources.

source.publisher: DHM and ICIMOD, via Nepali press
